authors_reviews.title: Nice pot
authors_reviews.text: This is absolutely gorgeous. Great size. Not heavy. Looks lovely with big plant in.
authors_reviews.author: David M.

authors_reviews.title: Beautiful, even nicer than the photos!
authors_reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful, measurements precise - my plant pot fitted perfectly inside. It's a decent size, and I think it's nicer looking than in the photos - both size and the copper colour. I think my peace lily will fare better against the puppy now it's sturdy and stable in a planter with some weight to it!It was well packaged in bubble wrap and a box - would actually make a lovely present. No drainage holes, which is perfect as my plant is already in a pot. It's twice the price of the planter that I was originally going to get, but it is definitely worth the money.

authors_reviews.title: Stunningly gorgeous in real life.
authors_reviews.text: This pot is absolutely gorgeous. The pictures do not do it justice at all. I was excited to receive it and when it arrived it was much higher quality than I thought it would be, it feels like it's worth twice the price, my only gripe is that it doesn't have any drainage, so just something to keep in mind, depending on the plant your housing in it. I love it so much I'm grabbing another one but in silver, I think they are an awesome bargain.
authors_reviews.author: S H Zamnoy

authors_reviews.title: A lovely pot which stands out nicely
authors_reviews.text: The silver pot is very strong and sturdy. It has a good weight which is not to bad once the compost is in it. Overall a good size and value for for your money.
